## Questions, answered.

Zapier and n8n are linear flowcharts — you draw the path, they walk it. Ghostbase is an LLM agent: you describe the goal in English, the model picks the tools, decides when to branch, and reports back. No nodes to wire. No conditionals to draft. The agent figures out the steps each run.

Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 by default. GPT-5 and GPT-5-mini available. Self-host customers can BYO keys including OpenRouter, so you can route to any model that supports tool use.

Every run is logged step-by-step in the dashboard with full input, output, tool calls, and self-reported status. You can pause an agent instantly — workflow triggers stop firing immediately. There's also a 15-minute stuck-run watchdog that aborts hung executions.

Yes. Enterprise tier includes a Docker Compose bundle and Terraform for AWS/GCP. Self-host means your data, your keys, your VPC. We provide updates and white-glove migration.

300+ apps out of the box: every major SaaS — Stripe, Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, Linear, Notion, GitHub, Sentry, Slack, Discord, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365. Plus direct IMAP/SMTP for any custom mailbox (IONOS, Fastmail, Hetzner, Posteo).

Agents pause and you get an email. Auto-top-up is available. Failed runs from credit-out are logged with status "insufficient_credits" so nothing fires silently.
